## Names

<a id="protection_commands"></a>
### [`protection_commands`](../../../../src/protection/disk_protection_3990.asm#L6) `$3990-$39AE`

*data*

Protection: the name # of the buffer channel ($3990), and the two block-read commands B-R: 5  0 33  5 ($3991) and B-R: 5  0 33  6 ($39a0), 15 bytes each: channel 5, drive 0, track 33, sectors 5 and 6.

<a id="protection_open_buffer"></a>
### [`protection_open_buffer`](../../../../src/protection/disk_protection_3990.asm#L9) `$39AF`

*routine*

Opens file 5 on the current device (FA) with secondary address 5 and the name # (a buffer in the drive).
